source: Genera un mapa de juego multijugador simple en una plaza al aire libre con pasto verde y un camino de piedra central. En el medio, coloca tres juegos diferentes de mesas redondas, cada una rodeada por cuatro sillas sencillas. Agrega lógica de script a las sillas: cuando dos jugadores diferentes se sientan en sillas que pertenecen a la misma mesa, aparece una interfaz de chat personalizada sobre la mesa y comienza una cuenta regresiva para iniciar la partida de 'Cadena de Palabras'. Si solo hay un jugador sentado, muestra un mensaje de texto flotante que diga: 'Esperando a otro jugador...'.

image_prompt.text: The open-air plaza itself as the gathering space - green grass throughout with a stone path down the centre
An even, clearly readable division of the plaza floor around the play areas
Three different sets of round tables in the middle of the plaza, each ringed by four simple chairs

layout_placement.text: Per-table seat detection that fires when two different players are seated at chairs belonging to the same table

notes: The custom chat interface, the start countdown and the floating 'Esperando a otro jugador...' message are screen-space and scripting; only the seat detection has a spatial footprint.
Word Chain itself is a text game with no space - the layout job is the plaza that hosts it.
Preset caveat: the Quiz preset's answer floor does not apply here, since answers are typed into a chat interface.

open_questions.ask: What should the plaza look like - modern park, old stone town square, stylised?
How large should the plaza be around the three tables?

coverage_missing.ask: Modern park, old stone square, or stylised?
How big is the plaza around the tables?

answers.ask: What should the plaza look like - modern park, old stone town square, stylised?
answers.answer: Un parque moderno y sencillo al aire libre, con pasto verde, camino central de piedra y mobiliario limpio y funcional.

answers.ask: How large should the plaza be around the three tables?
answers.answer: Una plaza pequeña y compacta, con las tres mesas claramente separadas pero próximas entre sí y rodeadas por suficiente pasto para circular.
